name: Nivika Fastigheter AB (publ)
summary: Nivika Fastigheter AB (publ) is a Swedish real estate firm specializing in the acquisition, management, and development of both residential and commercial properties throughout the country. Its extensive portfolio comprises a total of 191 properties, encompassing diverse asset types such as industrial, logistics, office, and community-focused facilities. Established in 2000, the company maintains its headquarters in Värnamo, Sweden.
